intro.source: Medha moved from TypeScript to Rust by progressive hybrid enhancement: hot routines ported behind a NAPI-RS bridge with a TypeScript fallback, the CLI kept as the daily driver, and the standalone native binary assembled last. Anvesa follows the same order.

callouts.text: claude proposes moving this plan to accepted: “the requirements and claims are settled”.

sections.title: Token-frugal primer with an anti-drift test

flags.text: Every claim holds but anv-35b is still open.

body.source: `anvesa primer [topic]` (and an MCP `primer` tool) serves 25-40 line topics: overview, wql, fusion, graph, indexing, grammars. A test fails when a CLI command or MCP tool is not covered by a topic.
